title: 全联盟的老家长
concept: A worn old doorway threshold polished bright by many footsteps, viewed close from inside looking outward. Outside the open doorway, a modest queue of ordinary citizens seen only from behind in work caps and headscarves, warmly lit interior light spilling across the threshold. The open accessible entrance is the hero, no portrait.
prompt: Create ONE finished Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon.
